summary_en: 1,200,000 shares (3.45% of shares outstanding), ¥3.0B upper limit, execution Aug 1, 2026–May 31, 2027. Method: open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange including ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange block trades. Acquisition contingent on market conditions.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: WingArc1st Inc. announced on July 14, 2026, that its board of directors has resolved to acquire treasury stock under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation. The acquisition program authorizes purchase of up to 1,200,000 ordinary shares (3.45% of issued shares excluding treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥3.0 billion. Execution window runs August 1, 2026, through May 31, 2027. The company will acquire shares via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including off-exchange block trades using ToSTNeT-3. The company states that current stock price levels do not adequately reflect its mid-to-long-term growth prospects, cash generation capacity, and future enterprise value. The board intends the program to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency as part of its capital allocation policy, thereby contributing to sustained enterprise value creation. Actual acquisition is contingent on market conditions and may be executed in full, in part, or not at all.
